source.generated_by: courtlab export (nothing in this file is hand-edited)

model.reference: Franks, Miller, Bornn, Goldsberry (2015); weights refitted on the ten ACB games
model.smoothing: 9-frame gaussian window, samples weighted by 1/sigma^2 with sigma = predError / 2.146

unowned_shooter.label: Shot off a catch with nobody assigned to the shooter for 1 s or more

baseline.label: his defender in place (under 3 ft beyond his normal spot)

pick_coverage.label: The last ball screen of each set possession, by how the two defenders played it
pick_coverage.unit: points per possession; stretch = the most any team-mate is pulled beyond his normal spot 1.2 s after the screen, ft

one_more_pass.label: Expected points of the shot by passes after the last labelled action

race.label: The pass against the man closing out
race.unit: ft/s, s, expected points per shot
race.value_label: how many times faster the pass travels than the defender runs

pass_speed.label: Complete pass, passer to receiver, median

closeout_top_speed.label: Top speed of a labelled close-out, median

onset.label: When the closing defender starts running at the receiver, after the pass leaves, median

late_start_price.label: Expected points of the shot when the close-out starts 0.4 s or more after the pass, minus earlier

open_three_by_shooter.label: A three off a broken rotation (defender 3 ft or more out of place, or nobody on him): what SkillCorner's quality says, and what was scored, by the shooter's season accuracy

crash.label: Offensive rebound when two or more team-mates crash, minus when none or one does

transition.label: Transition possessions: points by how many defenders were between the ball and their basket when it crossed into the front court

seconds_to_set.label: Seconds after the ball crossed until all five defenders were in the half they defend, median (0 when they already were; within 6 s and the chance)

shot_selection.label: Per team and game: points scored minus points SkillCorner's shot quality expected, per 100 field-goal attempts (fouled shots excluded)

closeouts.label: Possession points after a labelled close-out, by what the attacker did once the defender arrived

rim.label: Field goals from the restricted area (no foul): made, by whether a defender was within 4 ft at the release

quality_fit.label: logit(SkillCorner shot quality) ~ closest defender distance + catch-and-shoot + distance + release time + dribbles, per zone

rotations.label: Conceded shots with a counterfactual (only the defender's distance at the release is moved): expected points the rotation cost, per team and game
